Thanks Lydia — looping in Legal (Kimberly) and Sales (Aditya) to align on naming and the ingestion path. For clarity, here's the intake checklist and the exact manifest we require for automated ingestion into our evidence pipeline: 

- Required files: COI (PDF), Endorsement (PDF) if Additional Insured is requested, and a CSV manifest with metadata (carrier, policy number, effective/expiry, limits, addl insured entity).
- File naming convention: ZB_<company>_COI_<policy-number>_YYYYMMDD.pdf (example: ZB_ZenByte_COI_ABC12345_20280730.pdf)
- Manifest: CSV columns must be in header order: file_name, carrier, policy_number, coverage_type, limit, effective_date, expiry_date, addl_insured_names
- Upload endpoint: secure S3-presigned link or through our portal at https://redwood-drive.example.com/zenbyte/onboarding-manifest (broker preference).

Operational notes: our ingestion system will validate the CSV and PDF OCR fields; mismatches will create a flagged ticket for manual review which delays onboarding. If you plan to provide a bulk bundle, please include a single evidence_manifest.csv at the root of the upload.

Kimberly — please confirm precise naming for additional insured and whether you need "and its affiliates" language. Aditya — we're tracking this against ZB-2028-0921; any contractual sensitivity on offering onboarding concessions if evidence is delivered late?

Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: ZenByte Procurement <procurement@zenbyte.io>, Allied Insurance Broker <brokers@alliedins.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence for MSA / Order Form - coverage + additional insured

Markus — thanks, concise checklist. Internal legal guidance below and a small edit for the endorsement text to avoid ambiguity:

1) Additional insured name: please have the broker list exactly: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents" and include the entity address: 225 Bryant St, San Francisco, CA 94103. We prefer the broader phrase "and its affiliates" only when a corporate affiliate is explicitly a party; for the MSA it's OK to use officers/directors/employees/agents to be precise.
2) Coverage minimums (MSA standard):
   - Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
   - Professional Liability / E&O: $2,000,000 per claim / aggregate (if applicable)
   - Cyber/Privacy: $2,000,000 (if service processes customer data)
3) Retro-date: no retroactive date acceptable unless limited and documented. If broker requests retro-date earlier than policy inception, escalate to Contracts.

Please ask broker to supply a completed endorsement PDF (signed) rather than a template where possible. If the endorsement is pending, we can accept a signed broker letter acknowledging issuance timeline plus a target date.

Operational ask: mark the manifest CSV with column "legal_status" (values: accepted | pending | exception) so our ingestion can triage and route pending items to Contracts.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
